name: Sleep Actions
author: Eric van Riet Paap; original Battery Session by hungmi (https://github.com/hungmi)
description: Battery glyph and charge in the bar, plus sleep-time radio actions with per-sleep W/Wh statistics grouped by setting. Fork of hungmi.battery-session to measure suspend drain on Apple Silicon (Omarchy/Asahi).

barWidget.description: Battery session stats and sleep-time radio controls.
